risks: For exactly the layer-less feature module at issue, then requires a compliant layer name or directory, but unless[1] says a file carrying no layer segment is outside the rules. With no coder-facing precedence or conflict note, a weak coder can plausibly skip a required move/rename or change an exempt file.

The permitted layer vocabulary is only illustrative, while the coder must infer actual architectural responsibility and reconcile it with the nearest existing feature layout. For cross-cutting or ambiguous behavior, those cues may not identify a unique existing layer, despite the prohibition on inventing one.

unobservable: Whether S033 exempts a no-layer-segment feature module has no observable resolver: activation fires on that case while unless exempts it.
The output of the referenced test/vendored/build path classifier is not represented by supplied facts or concrete classification patterns.
A module's actual architectural responsibility is semantic; no observable fact or complete layer vocabulary is supplied for determining its owning layer.

review.summary: The rewrite faithfully preserves the reviewed source knowledge, including all shared-node content and the two structural compressions, so I agree with the auditor's PASS on fidelity. The preserved source contradiction nevertheless makes the layer-less case non-deterministic and leaves a weak coder without a safe decision procedure until that exception is authoritatively clarified.
